row.evidence: The Okta Integration Network lists a 'Progress Chef' app that 'supports automated user provisioning' (SCIM Create, Update, Deactivate), but Chef's own docs (Chef 360 1.7, Chef SaaS, Automate) document only SAML/LDAP sign-in and a user-accounts REST API, and the pricing page says nothing about SCIM.
row.notes: Unknown: SCIM provisioning is known only from Okta's OIN page (Progress Chef, updated Sep 28 2026, checks OIDC, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Entitlement Management); no Chef page documents a SCIM endpoint, its plan or price, and who built the Okta app is not stated. Pricing is per node per year (SaaS: Business $59, Enterprise $189, Enterprise Plus custom quote) with unlimited user seats, so per-user fields are null; the feature table's per-tier marks are icons and do not show SSO. Chef SaaS/Automate supports one SAML IdP (Azure AD, Microsoft 365, Okta, OneLogin, Ping, Tivoli) plus LDAP, with users not created locally; Chef 360 supports SAML IdPs for existing or invited users. Chef 360 has a documented REST user-accounts API (create local user, list, update, enable/disable, delete, roles, bulk create).

scim.notes: No SCIM page in docs.chef.io (main and Chef 360 1.7 sitemaps, 1,609 URLs) or the Chef 360 release notes; SCIM is known only from the Okta OIN listing (see idp_apps.okta).

auth.notes: api-key and api-secret headers, translated to signed requests by the API gateway.

endpoints.purpose: Get all users in the current tenant
Delete a user in the current tenant
Add a user to the current organization
Assign a role in the current organization unit

limitations.text: OAuth (externally managed) users are not supported by the user-accounts API; it manages local users.

user_api.notes: Chef 360 Platform API (self-managed and SaaS). The YAML also has GET/PUT /identity/user/{userId}, PATCH .../enable, and per-organization /users, /user/{userId}/enable|disable.

okta.notes: OIN page checks OIDC, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Entitlement Management (app id progresschef). Not documented by Chef.

entra.notes: Azure AD is a supported SAML IdP for Chef SaaS; no Microsoft Learn tutorial (chef-tutorial, progress-chef-tutorial 404).

onelogin.notes: OneLogin listed as a supported SAML IdP for Chef SaaS.

fallbacks.notes: Chef Automate treats SAML users as externally managed (no local account); Chef 360 SAML users must exist or be invited.
